text: What is posted online can leave traces even after it is deleted. Before your child posts, encourage them to ask: “Would I be happy for my teacher or grandfather to see this years from now? Does it reveal private information about me or others?”

review_defects.why: Arabic uses masculine singular (ابنك/شجّعه) but English shifts to gender-neutral 'your child' and 'them', altering the original referent.
